name: Assistive Contact Benchmark
summary: Presents a contact-rich benchmark for robot-assisted bathing with a deformable simulated human, calibrated against force measurements on a care manikin, and scores interaction quality alongside task success.
numbers: 140 runs per method; LLM state machine 72.9%→56.4% after force and region screening; VoxPoser 27.9%; π0.5 0.7%

why.xr: Direct contact with a vulnerable person.
